title_en: Hey you, beautiful white and red maiden

lines.en: - Hey you, beautiful white and red maiden,

lines.cyr: што си толку бела, бела и црвена.
lines.lat: što si tolku bela, bela i crvena.
lines.en: how are you so beautiful, so white and red.

lines.cyr: Дал си зима в' Солун зимувала,
lines.lat: Dal si zima v' Solun zimuvala,
lines.en: Did you spend your winters in Solun,

lines.cyr: дал си лете под шатор, шатор летувала?
lines.lat: dal si lete pod šator, šator letuvala?
lines.en: did you sunbathe under a tent, under a tent?
- Hey you maidens, my dear friends,

lines.cyr: не сум зима в' Солун зимувала.
lines.lat: ne sum zima v' Solun zimuvala.
lines.en: I did not spend my winters in Solun.

lines.cyr: Ни сум в' лето под шатор седела,
lines.lat: Ni sum v' leto pod šator sedela,
lines.en: I did not sunbathe under a tent, under a tent,
rather my mother birthed me like this.
- Hey you, white and red maiden,
